screening.reason: Exclusion 4 (no autism-vs-control analysis): the ABIDE I/II resting-state fMRI analysis is restricted to 172 autistic participants only, relating an ADI-R symptom network to connectome edges via connectome-based predictive modelling; it contains no typically-developing control group, no group-difference test and no diagnostic prediction/classification, so inclusion criterion 3 is not met.

kg_link.cohort_description: 172 male autistic participants aged 10-21 (ABIDE: n=127, ABIDE-II: n=45) with ADI-R scores; no control group.
evidence_quotes: we utilise data from 172 male autistic participants (10–21 years) from the autism brain data exchange (ABIDE, ABIDE-II) that completed resting-state fMRI and were assessed using the autism diagnostic interview (ADI-R).
